approvedConvention: Preserve existing namespace; use stable semantic camelCase suffixes; keep dynamic values as parameters; share only when owner, consumer and parameter contract match.
rationale: The strings are rendered in the Admin hierarchy editor as visible headings/hints/actions, stage-name field labels, accessible names, state labels and an empty stage message. Dynamic stage labels are kept as explicit parameters.
limitations: Proposal only; no product or canonical index change.
The shared action word “Adicionar” remains scoped to this specific control and is not shared with other Admin components.
Other stage card consumers and hierarchy groups remain outside this bucket.
